origin.description: Print captured source with prompts, then text, messages, warnings, errors, and plots.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An evaluation, or one piece of one: source, text, a condition, or a recorded plot.

origin.details: A continued line uses the continue prompt. A recorded plot is drawn. Messages and warnings are printed the way the R terminal prints them.
origin.example:
f1 <- function() {
  cat("1\n")
  print("2")
  warning("3")
  print("4")
  message("5")
  stop("6")
}
replay(evaluate("f1()"))
